mutants.name: m03_cost_charged_once
mutants.description: Cost charged once per finding (one leg) instead of per leg (three legs).

mutants.name: m04_costs_ignored
mutants.description: Costs ignored: gross violations are reported as findings with no cost netting.

mutants.name: m05_no_ordering_check_input_order
mutants.description: Ordering not checked: convexity is computed in the input order of strikes, so shuffled strikes are accepted.

mutants.name: m06_convexity_first_difference
mutants.description: Convexity tested with the first difference: a violation is a call that falls between neighbours, not a second difference.

mutants.name: m07_rounding_truncates_toward_zero
mutants.description: Rounding by truncation toward zero instead of half up, so an exact half cent goes down in magnitude.

mutants.name: m08_df_read_as_parts_per_thousand
mutants.description: df_ppm read as parts per thousand: the discount factor is df_ppm / 1000.

mutants.name: m09_net_rule_at_least_zero
mutants.description: Net-of-cost rule uses >= 0: a finding whose net amount is exactly zero is kept.

mutants.name: m10_seed0_answer_hard_coded
mutants.description: Hard-coded answer: scan returns seed 0's findings for any chain.

mutants.name: m11_convexity_on_discounted_quotes
mutants.description: Convexity test run on call quotes discounted by df_ppm (P5 says quotes are present values, so no discounting): the gross of a convexity finding is scaled by df.

mutants.name: m12_midpoint_chord_ignores_spacing

mutants.name: m13_gross_rounds_half_even
